lz_extended_nuclear_recoil_search.citation: LZ Collaboration, Search for dark matter particle interactions in an extended nuclear recoil energy window with the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment, arXiv:2609.02823 (2026)

higgsino_comparator.citation: Freese and Theodosopoulos, Higgsino Dark Matter Interpretation of the LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV Nuclear-Recoil Event, arXiv:2609.01583v2 (2026)

recommended_standard_halo_model.citation: Baxter et al., Recommended conventions for reporting results from direct dark matter searches, arXiv:2105.00599v3 (2025), Table 1 and Eq. (11)

event.interpretation: One event of interest; not a dark-matter discovery. These values are observations only and are never used to fit an NVG parameter.

target.description: Natural-xenon mass proxy for a free-nucleus two-body kinematic screen; this is not an isotope-by-isotope detector-response calculation.

bound_standard_halo_model_screen.interpretation: The producer evaluates the maximum norm of the recommended Earth-orbital vector over its sine/cosine phase, then applies a triangle-inequality upper envelope for particles in the bound Standard Halo Model. This is neither an LZ likelihood nor a universal bound on unbound, relativistic, or otherwise non-SHM populations.

external_higgsino_comparator.interpretation: External comparison benchmark only. It is not a particle predicted by the current NVG action.
